description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types used in a dataset. The chart contains ten slices, representing different categories of characters. These are, moving clockwise from the top: “Comic Characters” (red), “Movie Characters” (light blue), “Teleplay Characters” (medium blue), “Novel Characters” (cyan), “Game Characters” (teal), “Actors Influencers” (light green), “Musicians” (green), “Writers” (yellow-green), “Athletes” (yellow), and “Scientists Artists” (pink). The central section is labeled “Characters Real Characters” (light blue) and “Virtual Characters” (light blue). The chart includes a legend identifying each character type and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are not displayed within the slices, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding. The slices appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order based on their visual size, though this is not explicitly indicated.
